tweet.text:
Multi agent teams look like wasted spend in a lot of setups.

Vals AI says teams barely beat solo agents while costing up to 5.1x more tokens.

Only one out of four tests showed a measurable gain.

That means “add more agents” fails as a default scaling plan.

Coordination overhead eats the budget when every sub agent repeats the same reasoning.

The next upgrade will be routing.

One strong planner plus cheap checks will ship in products before big agent swarms do.

Where do you see swarms paying off?
